newsitem.title: INDIA: India ICICI to invest in company shares.
newsitem.headline: India ICICI to invest in company shares.

text.p: BOMBAY, Oct 24 (REuter) - The board of Industrial Credit and Investment Corporation of India (ICICI) has decided to buy shares from the secondary stock markets subject to certain conditions, its chairman Narayanan Vaghul said on Thursday.

Last Saturday, the Reserve Bank of India, in its monetary policy announcement for the second half of 1996/97 (April-March), said it was for the first time allowing banks to buy shares from the secondary market.
Vaghul said this would be the first time that ICICI would be buying shares from the stock market. Till now, ICICI had been buying shares from the primary market.
He who was addressing a seminar on Indian capital markets, and did not give more details.
